proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our Center Square parlor had 11-foot ceilings and crown that was cracked in three places. Ruth sent a drawing with every length measured before giving a price, and the final bill matched it to the dollar.
reviews.name: Devon A.

reviews.text: I used the shelving planner on the site, typed in 104 inches, and it said four bays. The finished bookcase has four bays, painted to match the trim, and the books do not bow the shelves.
reviews.name: Priya S.

reviews.text: Three window sills on our Troy rowhouse looked rotten. They probed each one and only one needed a new sill. The other two were patched for a fraction of the cost.
reviews.name: Gabe L.

reviews.text: The stair rail had been wobbling for years. Fixed in one morning, and they showed me the loose bolt in the newel that was causing it.
reviews.name: Lorraine F.

reviews.text: Our front door would not close in August and would not lock in January. They planed it, moved the strike plate, and it has worked through a full winter now. Clear schedule, clear invoice.
reviews.name: Omar H.

reviews.text: We needed a radiator cover for a bay window that is not square in any direction. They came twice to measure. It fits.
reviews.name: Celeste N.

reviews.text: Pantry went from two sagging boards to floor-to-ceiling shelves with a pull-out for the trash. Price was in the sample range they listed online, which is why I called in the first place.
reviews.name: Wes T.

proof.guarantee: Any joint, door or shelf we installed that moves out of tolerance in 2 years, we come back and set it right.
